text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x sucks.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.
Duster(x) ::: x is a duster.
Premises:
Suck(plungers) ::: Plungers suck.
Suck(vacuums) ::: Vacuums suck.
Suck(vampires) ::: Vampires suck.
Vacuum(space) ::: Space is a vacuum.
HouseholdAppliance(duster) ∧ Duster(duster) ∧ ¬Suck(duster) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Conclusion:
Suck(space) ::: Space sucks.
